import z3

n_golfers = 30
n_groups = 10
group_size = 3
n_weeks = 7

# Variables: g[w][p] = group of golfer p in week w
g = [[z3.Int(f"g_{w}_{p}") for p in range(n_golfers)] for w in range(n_weeks)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Each group assignment is between 0 and n_groups-1
for w in range(n_weeks):
    for p in range(n_golfers):
        s.add(g[w][p] >= 0, g[w][p] < n_groups)

# Each week, exactly group_size golfers per group
for w in range(n_weeks):
    for grp in range(n_groups):
        # Count golfers in this group: sum of (g[w][p] == grp)
        # Use Bool to Int
        cnt = z3.Sum([z3.If(g[w][p] == grp, 1, 0) for p in range(n_golfers)])
        s.add(cnt == group_size)

# No pair of golfers in same group more than once
# For each pair (p,q) with p<q, they can share at most 1 week
for p in range(n_golfers):
    for q in range(p+1, n_golfers):
        # Count weeks where they are in same group
        same_group = z3.Sum([z3.If(g[w][p] == g[w][q], 1, 0) for w in range(n_weeks)])
        s.add(same_group <= 1)

print("Constraints added. Solving...")
result = s.check()
print(f"Result: {result}")

if result == z3.sat:
    m = s.model()
    print("Solution found!")
    # Build the flat list
    sol = []
    for w in range(n_weeks):
        for p in range(n_golfers):
            sol.append(m.evaluate(g[w][p]).as_long())
    print(sol)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
